description:
Find where an IP address is: country, region, city, continent and approximate coordinates, for IPv4 or IPv6. City-level accuracy, not a street address. Data: IP Geolocation by DB-IP (db-ip.com), CC BY 4.0.

$0.002 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote. The first 3 calls a day through this tool server are free (no wallet needed).

When to use: You need roughly where an IP address is.
Parameters: ip: one IPv4 or IPv6 address. Private and reserved addresses are refused free.
Returns: country, region, city, continent and approximate latitude/longitude (city level, not a street address).

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

name: ip_lookup
title: IP address lookup
